projects.title: Website SEO Optimization
projects.description:
The website needs Google search engine optimization so that small businesses in Ghent can find LiveLit when they search for event lighting. Audit the current pages, fix the technical issues, rewrite the titles and descriptions of the ten most visited pages, and set up Search Console so the team can follow the results.

Deliver a short report the team can act on without help.
projects.note: I audited 42 pages, fixed the sitemap and canonical tags, and rewrote the copy of the top ten pages. Organic visits rose 38% in the first month.
